race.comment: SUMMER ROCKSTAR (8) hasn't raced since August last year when campaigning in NSW but a recent trial win at this venue suggests he is back in strong order. He could make an immediate impact in Queensland. BOSTON ASSASSIN (5) has been racing well of late. Finished third at his latest appearance over 2138m at Albion Park, beaten 2.75 metres. Meets a comparable field so makes each way appeal. SKYLAR BREE (6) will find this easier than the latest attempt when sixth over 1660m at Albion Park last time out. Can make an impact in this lie-up. WECANONLYDREAM (3)draws well and is in the mix following a sixth at his most recent appearance over 2138m at Albion Park.
